turns.content: In ARMLvania, each license plate has T-3 digits. How many positions are on a plate?
Digits come from 1 through 9, no digit may repeat, and the k-th digit must be at least k. How many choices are there for the rightmost position?

Now work from right to left. After positions k+1 through 8 have been filled, compare the size of the eligible set {k,k+1,...,9} with the number of already used digits from that set. How many choices remain at position k?
Check the constant-choice argument concretely at positions 8 and 7, including the case where the digit chosen at position 8 is 8 and the case where it is 9.
Use the choice count for all eight positions to calculate the total number of valid plates.
State the final count and summarize why distinctness does not make the number of choices shrink as we move left.
